title: A dated retirement, shutdown or end of life

id.description: Stable while the source keeps reporting the change.

kind.description: An AI model, a provider API, or a runtime or other software.

category.description: Finer than kind: model, api, runtime, language, framework, database, infrastructure, os or software.

event.description: What happens on the date: retirement, deprecation, removal, end of life and so on.

provider.description: The group it is listed under, such as openai, anthropic or nodejs.

name.description: The model, API or runtime as people write it.

modelId.description: The exact id a model goes by in its provider's API.

platform.description: The cloud the dates apply to (bedrock, vertex, azure), or null for the provider's own API.

version.description: A runtime's release line, such as 18.

symbol.description: The part of an API that goes, such as a request parameter.

dateKind.description: not_before: the provider only promised no sooner than this date.

regions.description: The only regions the date is given for (Amazon Bedrock lists dates per region), or null when it is not scoped. In the CSV, separated by spaces.

replacement.description: What the source names as the replacement.

updatedAt.description: When this entry's facts last changed.
